lines.en: I roll forward one step at a time.
My body is almost perfectly round.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可没什么能拦我
lines.en: I am slow, but little can stop me.

lines.zh: 我经过草丛，草被压出一道
lines.en: I pass the grass and press a line in it.
My short legs barely show.
I keep rolling straight down the road.
My shadow is a circle.
I hit a stone and swing half around.

lines.zh: 我的手臂很短，走起来摆得很快
lines.en: My arms are short and swing fast.

lines.zh: 我滚过一道小沟，颠了一下
lines.en: I roll over a ditch and bump.
I roll over a ridge and bounce.

lines.zh: 我的短腿几乎够不到地
lines.en: My short legs barely reach the ground.

lines.zh: 我停在路中间，像一颗球
lines.en: I stop in the road like a ball.

lines.zh: 我的脸在半边，看着前面
lines.en: My face sits on one side, looking ahead.
I sway slowly.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的圆面照得发亮
lines.en: The sun brightens my round face.
I watch the grass for movement.
I put my hands at my sides.
I spin once and stop.
I turn myself half around.
There is a small flower by the road.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把眼睛眨了一下
lines.en: I blink slowly.
I listen to wind over the grass.

lines.zh: 我的圆面上一道旧划痕
lines.en: There is an old scratch on my round face.

lines.zh: 我转了个角度，让脸朝太阳
lines.en: I turn so my face catches the sun.

lines.zh: 我把手指在身体上敲了敲
lines.en: I tap my fingers on my body.
I turn my whole body to you.
My face is aimed at you, small.
I roll forward a little.

lines.zh: 你不觉得我这样很好笑吗
lines.en: Do you not find me funny like this?
I tilt my head a little.
I want to come closer to look at you.
I lift my head, my face small.
I roll to your feet and stop.
Your legs are very tall before me.

lines.zh: 我滚半圈，从另一边看你。
lines.en: I roll half a turn to view you from the other side.
I smile and my face bunches up.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一点，怕挡路
lines.en: I roll back a little so as not to block.
I raise both hands.
Your shadow covers me exactly.
I try hard to look up at you.
My round face looks up; I don't retreat.
The blow rolls me half a turn.
I stop and wobble twice.
My face tips aside.
I roll slowly back to facing forward.
I roll crooked and hit the verge.
I stop and wobble badly.
My face tips to one side.
I slowly right myself.
My short legs tremble.
I roll into the grass at the roadside.
It smells like old tin.
I roll over, slowly.
I have no teeth, but I can swallow.
Let go; I'll roll over to catch it.
Do not move while I come near.
I bring my face closer.
I reach out a short arm.
I cannot reach; I must roll closer.
This is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，手慢慢举起来。
lines.en: I stare at it, hands slowly rising.
I want to hug it to my chest.
I open my mouth slowly.
You bounce off me.
Your knee hits me with a clang.
I roll half a turn and steady.
Our collision shakes the grass blades.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一下，我滚开了
lines.en: You kick me and I roll away.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，被弹回来
lines.en: I hit your leg and bounce back.
I spin half a turn before stopping.
I hit a stone at the roadside.
We meet from both sides.

lines.zh: 我的圆面贴在你的鞋上
lines.en: My round face presses your shoe.
She is round too.

lines.zh: 我们滚到一起，碰了一下
lines.en: We roll together and touch.
Her smile is wider than mine.
We roll along this road together.

lines.zh: 她滚过来，碰了我的侧面
lines.en: She rolls up and touches my side.
We roll down the little slope together.
Her face is even smaller than mine.
We stop side by side at the roadside.

lines.zh: 她笑起来整个身体都在动
lines.en: When she laughs, her whole body moves.

lines.zh: 我们一起转向声音的方向
lines.en: We turn toward the sound together.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，只能侧过去
lines.en: I cannot bend, so I tip sideways.

lines.zh: 我的手指很短，够了两下
lines.en: My fingers are short; I reach twice.
I pinch it up.
I hold it by my face to look.

lines.zh: 我侧过身体，一只手撑地
lines.en: I tip sideways with one hand on the ground.
I pinch it up with my fingers.
I lift it up beside my face.

lines.zh: 它掉在草地上，我滚过去
lines.en: It falls in the grass and I roll over.
I keep it under my body.
I look around again.
I stop, my face toward you.
I start to roll faster.
I stop, my face fully toward you.
My body starts to tip forward.
I roll one step, then stop.
My round body starts to tip forward.
My eyes open wide.

lines.zh: 我数了数我们之间的距离
lines.en: I count the distance between us.
I do not shout; it would frighten people.
I roll a little closer.
My face is serious in the light.
You retreat, and I roll after.
I roll after you.
I leave a pressed line behind me.
You run fast; I roll steadily.
I roll on, pressing a line behind me.
You go round a tree; I cannot quite.
I stop, then speed up.
I stay at your side.
You look back, and I slow.
I am in no hurry; the road is empty.
I close on you bit by bit.

lines.zh: 你跑到草地上，我也会滚
lines.en: You run onto the grass; I can roll there too.
I keep to your direction all along.
I ram with my whole body.
I roll over you.

lines.zh: 我的重量都在这颗圆球里
lines.en: All my weight is in this ball.
I hit and bounce back.
I roll my whole body into you.
I roll onto you.
I swat once.
I hit and bounce back.
All my weight is in this blow.
I roll back and hit again.
I butt your knee.

lines.zh: 我的身体在地上滚出声
lines.en: My body makes a sound rolling on the ground.

lines.zh: 路上先出现一个影子圆
lines.en: A round shadow appears on the road first.
I come rolling along.

lines.zh: 我停在路中间，转了个方向
lines.en: I stop in the road and turn.
My face is bright in the sun.
I raise a hand and wave.
A round shadow appears by the road first.
I roll onto this road.
I turn half around to face forward.
I stop and breathe twice.
My round face shines in the sun.

lines.zh: 我把一只短手臂举起来
lines.en: I raise one short arm.
A pressed line is added to the road.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的外壳，我从里面冒气
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I steam from inside.

lines.zh: 我一路滚下坡，越滚越快
lines.en: I roll down the slope, faster and faster.
I float, spinning without end.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得滚出很远
lines.en: The blast rolls me far away.

lines.zh: 有东西打在我身上，弹走了
lines.en: Something strikes me and glances away.
That force keeps me spinning.
Hunger flattens me a little.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我跳了一下
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I bounce.
No road below; I keep falling.
